name: Yatagarasu Roost
author: 0xSrcAura
summary: The Kasugai crow on your desktop — her eye wears the last notification's colour.
description: The other half of Yatagarasu: the crow herself, roosting on the desktop on her prism wire. Her own listener watches the session's notification bus and her eye wears the freshest word — LOW cyan, MEDIUM emerald, HIGH amber, CRITICAL rose, the calm prism when the wire is clear. Companion to the Yatagarasu notification design, whose scrolls are her voice.
tagline: The Kasugai crow on your desktop — her eye wears the last notification's colour.
